document_title: Mustard (Sarson/Raya) Package of Practices & Pest Management

sections.symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck cell sap from tender twigs, inflorescence, leaves, and siliquae (pods). Infested plants show curling of leaves, stunted growth, and pod failure. Secretes honeydew leading to sooty mold development.
sections.recommended_action: Spray only when ETL is reached (1.5–2.0 cm aphid colony on the central shoot or 20-25% infested plants). Apply Dimethoate 30% EC @ 250-300 ml or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 50-80 g in 150-200 liters of water per acre. To protect honeybees and pollinators, spray strictly in the late afternoon (after 3:30 PM).
sections.preventive_measures: Early sowing between October 10 and October 25 minimizes aphid attack. Yellow sticky traps @ 10-15 traps per acre help in early monitoring and trapping.

sections.section_title: White Rust (Safed Kungi) and Blight Management in Mustard
sections.disease_pest_name: White Rust (Albugo candida) and Alternaria Blight
sections.symptoms: Prominent chalky white blisters appear on the lower surface of leaves. Hypertrophy and malformation of floral parts (Staghead formation) leading to sterile flowers without seeds.
sections.recommended_action: Treat seeds before sowing with Metalaxyl 35% WS (Apron) @ 6 g per kg seed. On appearance of disease on foliage, spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil MZ) @ 2 g per liter of water (approx 400 g in 200 liters of water per acre).
sections.preventive_measures: Use resistant or tolerant varieties like RH-749, NRCHB 101, and DRMRIJ 31 (Giriraj). Maintain balanced plant nutrition and ensure proper field drainage.

sections.recommended_action: Apply 80 kg N, 40 kg P2O5, and 40 kg K2O per hectare. Application of Sulphur @ 20-25 kg/ha through elemental sulphur or Gypsum (200 kg/ha) increases oil content by 2-3%.
sections.preventive_measures: First irrigation should be given 30-35 days after sowing at rosette stage, and second irrigation at siliquae formation stage (60-65 days after sowing).
